Here is the full line-by-line transcription of the Latin parish register page shown in **image_ef72df.png**.

The text consists of standard Catholic baptismal entries from late 1872 to early 1873. Standard abbreviations (such as *Spons* for *Sponsores* / Godparents, and *Joannes Quinlan P.P.* for the parish priest) have been transcribed as written.

## Key Terms Breakdown

* **Die [X]** = On the [X] day
* **filia / filius** = daughter / son
* **Spons / Sponsoribus** = Godparents / Sponsors
* **In Ergastulo** = Noted in the Dec 27 entry, typically meaning a house of correction, workhouse, or jail hospital. The note appended to this entry mentions the parents belong to the nearby parish of *Fedamore*.
